title: 6G 320 MHz client matrix row
description: One matrix row emitted by scripts/wireless/6g320-matrix.sh on stdout as a single JSON line (schema 6g320-matrix/v1). The script runs a fixed local-source AP->STA arm and a fixed STA->AP RX arm against one 6 GHz 320 MHz client. A hardware skip prints the line "SKIP: no 320 client" instead of a row and exits 0. An arm with status invalid or error keeps its measured gbit_s inside arms.* but the row's ap_to_sta_gbit_s / sta_to_ap_gbit_s is null. association.width_mhz and association.nss are the minimum values observed around the two arms, which is how a width or NSS downgrade becomes visible.

record_type.description: One client and one pair of arms. The script emits one row per invocation.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the row was written.

interface.description: 6 GHz AP BSS interface from iw.

width_mhz.description: The AP BSS is required to be 320 MHz wide.

center1_mhz.description: center1 frequency reported by iw, null when unavailable.

ssid.description: BSS SSID; empty for a hidden SSID.

mac.description: Station MAC as printed by iw, lower case.

model.description: Client model from --client-model, e.g. Intel Wi-Fi 7 BE200.

driver.description: Client driver from --client-driver, e.g. iwlwifi or mt7925e.

country.description: AP regulatory country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); 00 means world.

width_mhz.description: Minimum tested-direction width across the non-error arms: AP tx width for AP->STA and AP rx width for STA->AP. 320 is the required value; 160 (or lower) means a downgrade and the affected arm is invalid.

nss.description: Minimum tested-direction NSS across the non-error arms: AP tx NSS for AP->STA and AP rx NSS for STA->AP. null when no arm reported an NSS token.

signal_dbm.description: Client signal at selection, from the signal avg or signal line.

source_path.description: Where the traffic originated. This harness's two fixed arms are AP-local, so it records local. 2.5G exists for a wired-feed matrix variant.

ap_to_sta_gbit_s.description: AP->STA throughput, only when arms.ap_to_sta.status is ok; null otherwise.

sta_to_ap_gbit_s.description: STA->AP throughput, only when arms.sta_to_ap.status is ok; null otherwise.

retries.description: Sum of the AP station tx retries deltas over the non-error arm windows that produced a counter delta; null when none did. Wi-Fi transmission retries, not iperf3 retries.

target_met.description: true only when arms.ap_to_sta.status is ok and ap_to_sta_gbit_s is at least target_gbit_s.

streams.description: iperf3 streams per arm; 2 matches the 2SS target.

client.description: Client iperf3 version string from the JSON start block, or null.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions such as a world regulatory domain, an unavailable signal, or an NSS below the expected value.

raw_dir.description: Directory holding row.json, the raw client iperf3 JSON, stderr, and the AP server logs.

width.description: Tested-direction width at the end of an arm: AP tx width for AP->STA, AP rx width for STA->AP. null when the station was not visible.

nss.description: Tested-direction NSS at the end of an arm: AP tx NSS for AP->STA, AP rx NSS for STA->AP.

signal.description: Station signal at the end of the arm, when reported.

status.description: ok: valid 320 MHz/NSS arm; invalid: a width or NSS downgrade, re-association or vanished station; error: the arm did not complete.

gbit_s.description: Measured throughput, retained for invalid and error arms as diagnostic data.

bytes.description: iperf3 end.sum_received.bytes for AP->STA, end.sum_sent.bytes for STA->AP.

seconds.description: iperf3 measurement seconds for the same sum.

tcp_retransmits.description: Sender TCP retransmits from iperf3 end.sum_sent.retransmits; null when absent.

width_mhz.description: Tested-direction width at the arm end.

nss.description: Tested-direction NSS at the arm end.

tx_retries.description: AP station tx retries delta during the arm.

tx_failed.description: AP station tx failed delta during the arm.

invalid_reason.description: Why the arm is invalid; null for ok and error arms.

error.description: Why the arm could not complete; null for ok and invalid arms.

command.description: Exact remote iperf3 command; empty when the arm was skipped before it ran.
